key: Ah, good day. Welcome to the Lapis Luxury Cycle Shop!
en: Ah, good day. Welcome to the Lapis Luxury Cycle Shop!
ja: ああ、こんにちは。ラピス高級サイクルショップへようこそ!

key: Can I interest you in purchasing one of our top-of- the-line models with a lifetime guarantee? Yours for a mere $100,000,000!
en: Can I interest you in purchasing one of our top-of- the-line models with a lifetime guarantee? Yours for a mere $100,000,000!
ja: 一生保証つきの最高級モデル、いかがですか? たったの$100,000,000でございます!
おや? 引換券をお持ちで?

key: Strange, the only one I gave out was for...
en: Strange, the only one I gave out was for...
ja: おかしいですね、私がお渡ししたのは確か……

key: Why don't I just take that for you?
en: Why don't I just take that for you?
ja: それでは、お預かりいたしましょうか。

key: Hm? It seems you don't have that much. We don't appreciate window-shoppers.
en: Hm? It seems you don't have that much. We don't appreciate window-shoppers.
ja: ふむ? そんなにお持ちでないようですね。冷やかしはお断りしておりますので。

key: Hm? Come in again when you're ready to experience true quality!
en: Hm? Come in again when you're ready to experience true quality!
ja: ふむ? 本物の品質をご堪能いただける準備が整いましたら、またお越しください!

key: I trust you've been pleased with your product?
en: I trust you've been pleased with your product?
ja: お買い上げの品には、ご満足いただけていますでしょうか?

key: As a side note, I'm required to say that we are now accepting new hires, and if you're interested, you can take an application from the counter.
en: As a side note, I'm required to say that we are now accepting new hires, and if you're interested, you can take an application from the counter.
ja: ちなみに、当店では現在新規採用を行っておりまして、ご興味があればカウンターで応募用紙をお取りください、とお伝えするよう言われております。

key: But I'm sure those of the rabble would never make it through our rigorous selection process anyway, so you mightn't as well even bother.
en: But I'm sure those of the rabble would never make it through our rigorous selection process anyway, so you mightn't as well even bother.
ja: もっとも、そのあたりの方々が当店の厳しい選考を通ることなど、まずあり得ないでしょうから、わざわざお手を煩わせるまでもないかと存じますが。

key: A stack of job applications for Lapis Bicycle Luxury sits on the counter.
en: A stack of job applications for Lapis Bicycle Luxury sits on the counter.
ja: カウンターに、ラピス高級サイクルの応募用紙の束が置かれている。
